title: Contractual Faculty (Assistant Professor)
qualification: Candidates should have a good academic record throughout, with a minimum of 55% marks (or equivalent grade) at the Master's degree level. A 5% relaxation in marks is available for SC/ST/BC (Non-Creamy Layer)/EBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates of the state, and for physically challenged persons of Bihar; however, both relaxations cannot be combined for the same candidate. || In addition to the Master's degree, candidates must satisfy one of the following conditions: || Qualified the National Eligibility Test (NET) for Assistant Professor conducted by UGC/CSIR or any UGC-accredited test; or || Awarded a Ph.D. Degree as per the UGC (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of Ph.D. Degree) Regulations, 2009 or 2016, and thereby exempted from NET; or || Registered for Ph.D. prior to the implementation of UGC Regulation 2009, subject to fulfilment of conditions such as award in regular mode, evaluation by at least two external examiners, an open Ph.D. viva voce, publication of two research papers (at least one in a refereed journal), and presentation of at least two papers in UGC/ICSSR/CSIR-sponsored conferences/seminars; or || Ph.D. obtained from a foreign university/institution ranked among the top 500 in the World University Ranking (QS, THE, or ARWU Shanghai) at any time. || NET/SLET/SET is not required for Master's programmes in disciplines for which NET/SLET/SET is not conducted by UGC, CSIR, or a similar accredited body.
age_limit: The minimum age for appointment to the post of Assistant Professor is 21 years, and the maximum age shall not be more than 43 years as on 1 August 2026. Age relaxation is applicable to candidates belonging to reserved categories, in accordance with the guidelines issued by the Government of Bihar.

title: Police Sub-Inspector (General Closed Cadre)
qualification: Candidates must hold a graduate degree or an equivalent qualification as on 01-08-2025 to be eligible for the Police Sub-Inspector (General Closed Cadre) post.
salary: The post of Police Sub-Inspector (General Closed Cadre) carries Pay Level-6 as per the notification. The official notification does not mention a specific in-hand salary figure.
age_limit: The age limit is calculated as on the cut-off date of 01-08-2025, based on the date of birth recorded in the Matriculation or equivalent certificate. The category-wise age limits are given below. || Additional age relaxation is available for specific categories: || Bihar government servants seeking promotion to a higher pay scale/cadre, with a minimum of 3 years of regular service, are eligible for a 5-year relaxation in the maximum age limit. || Ex-servicemen applying for civil posts get a relaxation of 3 years plus the length of their defence service, provided their actual age does not exceed 57 years as on the cut-off date.
application_fee: The application fee is the same for all category male and female candidates and must be paid online. || Application Fee: Rs. 100/- (for all categories) || Accepted payment modes: Net Banking, Credit Card, Debit Card and UPI || Bank charges applicable on Net Banking/Credit Card/Debit Card transactions must be borne by the candidate || Application fee once paid successfully will not be refunded
selection_process: Selection to the post of Police Sub-Inspector (General Closed Cadre) will be made through a three-stage process consisting of a Preliminary Exam, a Main Exam and a Physical Efficiency Test (PET).
